entities.summary: Georgi Stankov is a boxer from Bulgaria. He competed for Bulgaria in the 1968 Summer Olympics held in Mexico City, Mexico in the light-heavyweight event where he finished in third place. He returned to the Olympics four years later in Munich but lost in the first round. Georgi Stankov was a athletes & competitors from Pernik (b. 1943-08-10, Pernik). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
